headers.//: Fragments are always requested as ?v=<content hash of every fragment>, so a rebuild changes the URL. They can therefore be cached permanently — this is what makes page turns instant on a return visit.
Artwork and ornaments change rarely; a month fresh, then served instantly from cache while it revalidates in the background.
Not content-hashed, so kept short — but stale-while-revalidate means a repeat visit never waits on the network for them.
book.json carries the version that busts the fragment cache, so it must always be checked.
